Show the difference between append() and extend().

Supplied answer
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = [1, 2, 3]
a.append([4, 5])
print(a) # [1, 2, 3, [4, 5]] -> nested list
b.extend([4, 5])
print(b) # [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] -> flat list
Note: Very common interview question. append() adds the whole object as one item.
